_comment: Sample reviewed proof-module manifests (PRD v2 §21.3). RESEARCH_ONLY entries are visible references, never executable. ADMITTED entries may be ASSESSED offline; execution is gated separately by TRASHSCAN_ENABLE_LAB_* flags, a distinct proof plan + attestation + fresh administrator approval, and real-lab/recovery gates (Phases 15-16). Shipping a manifest is NOT admission of executable modules for a real engagement — a human admits actual module revisions with their effect/recovery contracts. No module here performs any action in Phase 13.

modules.claim: Demonstrates command execution on an isolated lab host by triggering the vsftpd 2.3.4 backdoor (bind shell on 6200/tcp) and running one benign marker command, then stopping the session.

prerequisites.description: Target bound to a registered, isolated lab fixture (Phase 15)

modules.admitted_effect: Opens the backdoor bind shell on 6200/tcp and runs ONE benign marker command (echo <nonce>) to prove code execution; no persistence, no file writes, no credential access; stops the session on completion.
modules.expected_effect: A single bounded exploit run; one marker command; session stopped; snapshot restore on completion.
modules.negative_control: A patched vsftpd (not 2.3.4) MUST NOT yield a session; run against the patched control host to confirm the result is not a false positive.

modules.claim: Demonstrates that an exposed configuration file is readable by reading a single disposable administrator-seeded marker value, then exits.

prerequisites.description: Approved HTTP service reachable on the surface
Target bound to a registered, isolated lab fixture (Phase 15)

modules.expected_effect: Reads one disposable seeded marker; no writes, no secrets, no shell; single request; exits with a fixed bounded result.

modules.claim: Reference material only; visible for context, never executable.
